blocks.heading: Compare the Practical Paths
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: Nine routes, ordered by growth room

rows: 1. Plant data, mapping and science writing Scalable
NGOs, consultants, research teams and publishers pay for a finished species list, a vegetation map or a clear report. They trust a public sample with dates and sources.
BSc or MSc Botany, plus free mapping software (QGIS), basic statistics and clear English. You can start without a licence or an exam.
2. Nursery, floriculture and landscape Scalable with a business layer
Homes, housing societies, farmers, institutions and landscapers. They trust healthy plants they can see and a neighbour who bought from you.
BSc Botany or Horticulture, plus time working in a live nursery. Salaried nursery jobs exist, but we found no sourced pay figures, so we print none.
3. Tissue culture and planting material Scalable with a business layer
Nurseries and growers who need healthy, same-quality plants in bulk. They trust a batch record and independent test results.
BSc or MSc Botany plus a lab internship in culture media and sterile work. Employed lab roles come first.
4. Herbal and AYUSH raw materials Scalable with a business layer
Herbal and AYUSH makers, exporters and traders. They trust correct plant identification, clean batches and written records.
MSc Botany with ethnobotany or pharmacognosy topics, plus raw drug identification. Quality roles at manufacturers are the usual start.
5. Ecology and environment consulting Scalable with a business layer
Project developers who need environmental reports, and NGOs. They trust a field record, species lists and references from project leads.
MSc Botany or Ecology. Accredited consultancies field named experts by subject, including ecology and biodiversity, under the Quality Council of India NABET scheme. Check its current rules.
6. Seed, crop protection and plant health Scalable with a business layer
Seed and agri-input companies, testing labs and farmers. They trust lab discipline and farm-level results.
BSc or MSc Botany with plant pathology or seed technology. The company and exam detail sits in our plant and agricultural biotechnology guide.
1. Plant data, mapping and science writing Scalable
Freelance mapping and survey analysis, then a small consulting service. Writers can add a newsletter. Skill sells remotely to many clients.
2. Nursery, floriculture and landscape Scalable with a business layer
Your own nursery, a plant-care subscription for offices and societies, or a landscape and garden service. Water, land and seasons are real costs.
3. Tissue culture and planting material Scalable with a business layer
A recognised production unit. The national scheme has a capacity bar and testing steps, set out in the next section.
4. Herbal and AYUSH raw materials Scalable with a business layer
Supply of identified and tested raw material, contract cultivation with farmers, or a small branded product line. Licences differ by product and state, so verify them.
5. Ecology and environment consulting Scalable with a business layer
Ecological survey and biodiversity reports once you have a field record and a small team. See our environmental science guide for the wider field.
6. Seed, crop protection and plant health Scalable with a business layer
A plant-health advisory or testing service. Seed testing and sale rules differ, so check what needs a licence.

BSI Project Assistant (16 posts)
20,000 x 12 = Rs 2,40,000 a year before HRA. These 16 posts are 64 percent of the 25 posts in the notice.
BSI Project Associate-I (8 posts)
31,000 x 12 = Rs 3,72,000 a year. This is 84 percent of the CSIR JRF stipend.
BSI Research Associate-II (1 post)
61,000 x 12 = Rs 7,32,000 a year, for one post, on a contract that ends with the project.
CSIR-UGC NET JRF, then SRF
37,000 x 12 = Rs 4,44,000; 42,000 x 12 = Rs 5,04,000. A fellowship is training, not a post.
Andhra Pradesh Forest Range Officer (notification 16/2026)
The lowest step, 48,440 x 12 = Rs 5,81,280 a year, before the scale grows. Four posts for a whole state.
Indian Forest Service
Verify every date on the UPSC notice. The service is long, and our biology guide has the full subject list.

figures.source: Rules to check The Department of Biotechnology runs the National Certification System for Tissue Culture Raised Plants. A DST notice says a production facility must be fully operational and have a minimum capacity of 5 lakh plants a year to be recognised, and recognised units get batches tested by accredited labs.

blocks.heading: Fees, Free Learning and the Msc Question

figures.label: Education Budget
figures.source: Our strongest suggestion: spend about 10 percent of the whole education budget on college, and treat 20 percent as the point where you need proof for that exact course. On a Rs 8 lakh budget that is Rs 80,000 and Rs 1.6 lakh. The remaining money buys a laptop, a camera, field travel, rent between contracts and a second skill.
